card: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills
scope: Whole card candidate; independent reviews and integrated schema159 acceptance remain
implementation: Conditional cumulative tax only on creatures attacking the controller, locked after declaration taps; distinct owned payment phase, typed payment and cancellation actions, selective mana rollback and funding search. Zero-tax path retains existing attack commit.
wire: Schema160: Pending attack_payment, public optional attack_payment player/generic, PayAttackCost(payment), AbortAttackPayment, CancelAttackDeclaration, mana-payment domain, selected declarations visible during locked payment.
source: Complete Oracle body and pinned Java class and helpers in paired provenance; exact input files matched pinned revision. Rules CR508.1a-k and 508.4c govern payment timing, restrictions and entering attacking.
limitations: Final inherited trace row audit and full release acceptance must be done at integration.
Independent reviewers must audit overlap with Were-Worm's postpayment combat event and the existing selective mana rollback and nested funding continuation.
The synthetic post-tap predicate checks the projection helper, rather than an authored continuous effect that grants a tax when another creature taps.
